title: Draft operator procedures (pre-dispatch checks and refusal criteria)
context: RideBelt is an open, safety-critical Hee-Lee Oss project: an optional rider-worn backup restraint (low hip belt + short tethers; optional clip-on Shoulder Module or one-piece Integrated Harness) that latches into an open seat anchor standard (RAS). ALL safety content is DRAFT and not for use until a credentialed engineer signs off at the MVP gate (GOVERNANCE.md). Never remove a DRAFT banner, never give instructions for wearing or attaching anything to a ride, never copy text from paid standards (cite by number and title only), never name private individuals or incident victims, and respect the patent design-arounds in docs/research/patentability-fto.md. RAS adds operator steps: checking clipped-in status, module requirements per ride class and indicator reading (REQ-O1, O4, H28). Risk tier high: requires credentialed expert review before release.
objective: Draft an operator procedure template: primary-restraint checks first (unchanged), then RideBelt checks, indicator reading, refusal criteria and record-keeping.
acceptanceCriteria: States that primary-restraint checks are unchanged and come first
Every step traces to a REQ or hazard ID
Nothing implies RideBelt can be used today
Merged as DRAFT only (banner intact); release requires MVP-gate Safety Engineer sign-off (GOVERNANCE.md)
